answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own raven record, and its own share of the orchard quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The tundra ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1770 identities would post 3342 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
